heroDescription: Learn Korean step by step with simple lessons, real conversations, interactive quizzes and beautiful Korean culture.
aboutHeadline: Hi, I’m Dafrosa. Korean brought two worlds closer.
aboutLead: JifunzeKikorea is where I share my love of Korean language and culture in English and Kiswahili.
aboutStory: I started this space to make the first steps feel less intimidating. We can learn Hangul, pick up useful words, and practice everyday phrases one small piece at a time.
aboutMission: My hope is that you find something here that makes you curious enough to keep going.
